Our recruitment process

 

Our recruitment process is designed to be clear, fair, and candidate-friendly. While steps may vary depending on the role, seniority, and location, here’s the typical journey:

  • Step 1 - Apply: Submit your application online, highlighting your skills and experience.
  • Step 2 - CV Pre-Screening: Our recruiters review your profile against role requirements.
  • Step 3 -  Online Assessments (if applicable): Some roles may include technical tests prior to the interview.
  • Step 4 -  Interview: A 60–90-minute interview, conducted online or onsite, depending on role and location. For some positions, a second-step interview may be organised to dive deeper into your skills. The interview is a chance for you to get to know us - our culture, ways of working, and opportunities - just as much as it is for us to learn about you.
  • Step 5 -  Decision & Offer: After careful evaluation, we provide feedback and make hiring decisions promptly. Successful candidates receive an offer and guidance on the next steps.

At Nokia, we want every candidate to be able to perform their best. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, please let us know. All requests are treated confidentially.

 

Using AI in your application and interview preparation

At Nokia, we embrace technology that supports a fair, efficient, and positive candidate experience. We understand that many candidates use Artificial Intelligence tools when preparing their applications or getting ready for interviews. This is fully acceptable, as long as AI is used responsibly and in a way that reflects your genuine experience and capabilities.

  • Using AI when submitting your application

  • Using AI when preparing for interviews

Using AI when submitting your application

If you choose to use AI tools, please keep these guidelines in mind:

  • Keep your voice authentic: AI can help structure or draft your responses, but your application should represent your own experience and achievements.
  • Review content carefully: always verify the accuracy and relevance of AI-generated text.
  • Tailor your answers: ensure your application reflects the specific role you are applying for; avoid generic or overly broad responses.
  • Be truthful: AI should support your application, not enhance or misrepresent your skills or background.
     

Using AI when preparing for interviews

AI can be helpful in your preparation. For example, it can support you in:

  • Practicing typical interview questions and refining your responses.
  • Structuring examples (e.g., using the STAR methodology).
  • Researching the role or summarizing publicly available information about Nokia.
  • Reviewing your answers for clarity or impact.
  • Conducting mock interview simulations to build confidence.
  • Generating ideas for thoughtful questions to ask your interviewer.

AI can be a great preparation tool, but during the interview, we encourage you to focus on being present, authentic, and engaged. We want to get to know you - your strengths, your experiences, and your motivation. Our goal is to use technology in ways that enhance fairness and inclusivity, while keeping the human element at the centre of our hiring process.

AI Statement: Nokia embraces the strategic use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) within our recruiting process to enhance the candidate experience and significantly improve our operational efficiencies. By leveraging AI-powered tools, we aim to create a more responsive and equitable journey for all applicants. Concurrently, we advocate for the intelligent, ethical, and safe use of AI by candidates and applicants when preparing and submitting their applications for our roles. This includes ensuring that any AI-generated content is thoroughly reviewed for accuracy, originality, and relevance, and that its use aligns with principles of transparency and integrity. Our goal is to foster a recruitment environment that benefits from technological advancements while upholding fairness, authenticity, and human oversight.

US or Canadian Applicants: Nokia is committed to ensuring that our online application process provides equal employment opportunities to all job seekers, including individuals with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to search for a job opening, submit an application, or participate in the recruitment process, please contact us at peoplecare@nokia.com.

Nokia is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. At Nokia, employment decisions are made regardless of sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, ethnic origin, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, physical or mental disability, genetic information or ancestry, protected Veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
